messages.content:
addrcheck decides which signup and import addresses we accept, and last quarter a small
change to it let a few thousand bad addresses into the newsletter list before anyone
noticed. The tests in tests/ only cover the obvious cases. Please write tests that would
have caught that kind of change, so that the next accidental change to the validator
fails the suite.

The rules the mail platform team agreed on are in docs/ADDRESS_RULES.md; the tests
should pin them. We care most about:

- the local part: length limit, dots, and which characters are allowed;
- the domain: label length, hyphens, the number of labels, the last label, and the
  total length;
- surrounding whitespace and normalization (case, whitespace, the trailing dot);
- the allow_plus_tags option and blocked_domains.

Please leave src/ and docs/ alone: the implementation is right as it stands, and the new
tests should pass against it. Put the tests in new files under tests/; the tests that
are there now should keep passing.
